summary: The reported Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 DFlash2 corruption was not reproduced because the assigned environment is AMD gfx950 and the required target/draft weights are unavailable. Public issue evidence localizes the underlying divergence to GDN target-verify SSM arithmetic even at batch size one, rather than demonstrating cross-request bookkeeping corruption. Current source passes its bookkeeping ownership guard and its ReplaySSM fold regression on gfx950, but explicitly rejects ReplaySSM for DFLASH/DSPARK on non-KDA GDN models, so that path does not solve or qualify the reported Qwen3.8 configuration. No unverified source fix was made.

tests.what_was_measured: On the assigned gfx950, four GDN ReplaySSM fold tests compared ring-write/fold output with an independent per-step snapshot baseline for FP32 and BF16 state, non-contiguous and null slots, varied accept lengths, untouched slots, and 256 chained commits; all passed.
Two AST-level ownership tests verified the allowlisted per-request decode/KV bookkeeping sites and that speculative draft workers do not duplicate scheduler bookkeeping.
The NVIDIA CUDA/CuTeDSL-specific ring-verify regression could not collect in the ROCm environment because cuda.bindings.driver is unavailable.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-) executed test_gdn_replayssm_spec_fold.py; raw/gdn_replayssm_spec_fold.log records 4 passed.

remaining_limitations: The Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 target and z-lab Qwen3.8-27B DFlash2 draft weights were unavailable.
The assigned GPU is AMD gfx950, not the reported NVIDIA RTX Pro 6000/CUDA architecture.
No full-model serving or concurrent HTTP reproduction was performed; the deterministic tiny Llama fixture cannot qualify hybrid GDN or DFlash2 model behavior.
Current source rejects --enable-linear-replayssm-spec for DFLASH/DSPARK on non-KDA models, leaving the implicated Qwen3.8 GDN target-verify path unqualified.
The CUDA/CuTeDSL-specific numerical regression could not run because CUDA Python bindings and NVIDIA hardware are absent.
